subject: Post-demo: context profile + preliminary cost targets
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Huang <sophia@fintechco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: context profile + preliminary cost targets

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Below is a short recap and a set of preliminary cost targets for discussion with your team. Please flag anything I misremembered.

Recap (what I took away)
- Primary integration: in-product assistant for transaction support and compliance checks.
- Typical user flow: short system prompts + customer text -> 1-2 follow-up assistant messages; average session 3-4 model calls.
- Expected monthly active users (MAU) in year 1: 40k (pilot -> phased rollout).
- Peak QPS needs: low single-digit per-second per region, bursty at end-of-month.

Context/profile numbers (you shared rough numbers on call):
- Avg prompt tokens per call (prompt + system + history): ~1,100 tokens (we'll call it 1.1k).
- Avg completion tokens per call: ~800 tokens.
- Ratio completion/prompt: ~0.73
- Percent of calls needing extended context (user history + attachments): ~12% expected to require 32k context; ~2% might require 128k for long legal doc parses. Rest (~86%) fit within 8k.
- Expected tokens/month (baseline calc): 40k MAU * 10 calls/user/month * (1.1k + 0.8k) tokens ≈ 720M tokens/month (baseline).

Preliminary pricing targets (to align on budget range):
- You said budget for inference is roughly $5k–$12k/month during pilot, scaling later.
- To convert to unit economics, if we price at $X per 1M tokens, your monthly cost = X * (tokens_month / 1,000). Example scenarios below.

Scenario math (round numbers):
- Baseline tokens/month: 720M -> 720 * $/1M.
- If unit price = $2, then cost = $1,440/month.
- If unit price = $8, then cost = $5,760/month.
- If unit price = $15, then cost = $10,800/month.

Context-tiered cost impact (illustrative):
- 86% @ 8k: 619M tokens/month
- 12% @ 32k: 86M tokens/month (higher model perf/cost mix)
- 2% @ 128k: 15M tokens/month
- Weighted average cost depends on whether 8k/32k/128k variants carry different $/1M.

Action items / asks for next step
1) Can you confirm the avg prompt/completion numbers above (1.1k/0.8k) and the % split across 8k/32k/128k?
2) If you have a target $/1M tokens or target monthly spend for pilot, share that so we can line up scenarios. In particular, what would you consider an acceptable target $/1M tokens to meet procurement's budget?
3) If you want, we can run a quick sample-by-example with your anonymized telemetry (1–2 days of logs) to produce a tighter token projection — would that be useful?

Attachments: I attached a lightweight pricing workbook and a sample context-profile CSV (redwood_pricing_model_v1.xlsx, fintech_context_profile.csv).

Thanks — I can follow up with a short pricing scenario doc once you confirm the numbers.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

---

From: Sophia Huang <sophia@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context profile + preliminary cost targets

Hi Marissa — thanks for the tidy recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- The avg tokens you listed are close. Our engineering telemetry shows median prompt ~1.0k, mean ~1.15k (heavy tail), completion median ~650, mean ~820. For planning use the means you used (1.1k / 0.8k).
- Context split: roughly what you have — ~85% under 8k, ~13% 32k, ~2% 128k. 128k calls are rare but we want to support them.
- Pilot budget: procurement wants to keep pilot spend under $9k/month total. If we exceed that, procurement will need director sign-off.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you provide a clear per-1M breakdown for 8k vs 32k vs 128k contexts (e.g., $/1M tokens for each variant) and an example blended rate given our context mix?
2) We need to show procurement an expected pilot spend table (3 scenarios: optimistic/expected/conservative) with simple math for tokens -> $ to justify the pilot.

If you can get that to us by EOD Thursday (05/06), procurement can prep a PO template.

Thanks — Sophia
Head of Product, FinTech Co
sophia@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Huang <sophia@fintechco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 07:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context profile + preliminary cost targets

Sophia — thanks, that's helpful. Attached is a short table (also pasted below) with three pilot scenarios and per-1M price tiers. Assumptions: 8k tier price is our baseline inference unit; 32k and 128k have higher cost multipliers due to model/compute footprint (illustrative).

Per-1M price assumptions (pilot list price, negotiable):
- 8k variant: $6.00 / 1M tokens
- 32k variant: $18.00 / 1M tokens (≈3x 8k)
- 128k variant: $60.00 / 1M tokens (≈10x 8k)

Blended example using your % split (86/12/2):
- 8k: 619M tokens * $6 = $3,714
- 32k: 86M tokens * $18 = $1,548
- 128k: 15M tokens * $60 = $900
- Blended total ≈ $6,162/month (≈ $8.56 per 1M tokens on aggregate)

Three pilot scenarios (rounding):
- Optimistic (20k MAU): tokens ~360M -> blended ≈ $3,081 (below your $9k cap)
- Expected (40k MAU): tokens ~720M -> blended ≈ $6,162 (within $9k)
- Conservative (60k MAU / adoption surprise): tokens ~1.08B -> blended ≈ $9,243 (slightly above $9k)

Notes and options to hit procurement target:
- We can offer a pilot discount (one-time) to keep Expected scenario under $9k. Example: 20% off blended for first 3 months -> Expected ~$4,930.
- Alternatively, we can gate 128k calls behind a higher SLA/approved seat (rate-limit) to reduce immediate spend.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm whether you prefer a temporary pilot discount vs limiting long-context usage.
2) If discount route, I can loop Jordan (cc'd) for a written pilot pricing approval and get an approval code.
3) If limiting 128k calls, provide us with policy you want enforced and we'll prepare a rate-limit rule.

I'll wait for your direction; Jordan can prepare the PO/quote language once we have the preferred path.

Best,
Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Huang <sophia@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context profile + preliminary cost targets

Hi Sophia — Jordan here (SE) — quick note on pricing approval. Markus has approved a one-time pilot discount of 25% off the blended rate for the first 90 days for FinTech Co, limited to the Expected scenario (up to 800M tokens/month). I'll issue a quote with the discount and add the rate-limit clause for 128k calls (soft cap by default) unless you authorize otherwise.

I'll attach the formal quote and a short SOW template for procurement. If FinTech can sign the PO by the end of next week we'll table the pilot terms.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
